# MD View 1.0.0-rc.9

The ninth public release candidate of MD View: a native Markdown, text, and code editor for
Windows, macOS, and Linux, built with Rust and egui. No webview.

## Highlights

- **Mermaid diagrams as on GitHub.** Diagrams now render with `merman`, a Rust port of Mermaid's
  own parsers, dagre layout, and themes. Complex diagrams that used to overlap lay out the way
  GitHub shows them: nested subgraphs, composite states, and sequence fragments (`alt`, `loop`,
  `par`, notes, activations). Light mode uses Mermaid's default theme and dark mode its dark
  theme; labels are measured with the font that draws them, so they fit their boxes. Tall
  diagrams keep their natural size. Still no browser and no JavaScript engine.
- **Editor scrollbars you can see.** The horizontal scrollbar for long lines (and the vertical
  one) stays visible at rest and is wide enough to grab. Before, its handle was invisible unless
  the pointer was over the text, so a Markdown file in Edit mode showed no way to follow a long
  line.
- **No redraws while idle.** An idle window no longer repaints twice a second to watch open
  files for outside changes. The workspace watcher and a small background poller wake the window
  only when a file changed, which matters most on virtual machines, remote desktops, and other
  software-rendered sessions.

Everything from the earlier candidates is included:

- **Video with nothing to install (rc.8).** Pure-Rust decoders for MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI,
  MPEG-TS/PS, and FLV with H.264, HEVC, AV1, VP8, VP9, MPEG-1/2/4, and more, with sound.
- **Horizontal scrollbar only when needed (rc.7).** It appears only when a line is wider than the
  view, and never with soft wrap.
- **More file types (rc.6).** Editable spreadsheet grid for CSV/TSV, PDF and video viewers,
  animated GIF/WebP/APNG, more image formats including JPEG XL, richer animated SVG, and
  whole-fraction hover in the formula editor.
- **Equation gallery and formula editor (rc.5).** Σ gallery, √x editor with live preview,
  template palette, source-to-formula hover, and double-click editing.
- **System clipboard (rc.4)** and **editor behavior and the Markdown formatting bar (rc.3).**
- **From the earlier candidates:** split view with exact sync, GitHub Markdown parity, Oniguruma
  highlighting, CJK text, large files, the explorer that follows tabs, and the desktop packages.

## Install

Download the asset for your platform and verify it against `SHA256SUMS`:

| Platform | Preferred asset |
|---|---|
| Linux | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.9-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `mdview_1.0.0.rc.9_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora / RPM | `mdview-1.0.0.rc.9-1.x86_64.rpm` |
| macOS | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.9-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.9-windows-x86_64.msi` |

Everything is built in, video and its sound included. The macOS and Windows RC builds are **unsigned**. Gatekeeper and SmartScreen may
ask for an extra confirmation. Signing and notarization remain final 1.0.0 release-operator steps.

Documentation: https://jigonzalez930209.github.io/md-view-rs/

## Checksums and SBOM

The release includes a combined `SHA256SUMS`, `latest.json`, and `sbom.cdx.json`. Use
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` on Linux/macOS or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.

Full changelog: https://github.com/jigonzalez930209/md-view-rs/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
